Collecting K=1/2*m1*v1^2+1/2*m2*v2^2 gives M11=(m1+m2)l1^2+m2l2^2+2m2l1l2*cos(q2)=23, M12=M21=m2l2^2+m2l1l2*cos(q2)=15, M22=m2l2^2=12 kg m^2.
